title: Implement permission engine and approval-pause handoff
verify: Permission decision happens before every side effect.
Risky actions pause for exact scoped approval and cannot be self-approved by the model.
evidence_required: Permission matrix tests for read_only, draft_only, write_local/write_internal, identity_access, privileged_admin, safety_sensitive, process_execution, network_open_world, and destructive risk classes.
Approval-pause evidence with scoped approval request refs and structured observation.
constraints: Permission decisions record redacted args or argument hash, ActorContext ref, resource scope, PlantAccessGrant result, policy rule, approver when present, timestamp, and trace ref.
Draft/propose and commit/approve remain separate for risky side effects.
invariants: The model cannot approve its own action.
Physical-action advice requires Safety Gate path and authorized human approval where physical action is involved.
verification_targets: Permission correctness, approval correctness, and side-effect-before-permission regression evals.
